title: Lo Siento — EN/AR/MI (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar Arabic Maori language learning warm baritone 98bpm upright bass brushed snare trilingual true story family grief bilingual character portrait
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Corey sent the link. Kevin Sanders. Thirty-one. Free spirit.
Chas replied two words in Spanish: Lo siento.
Corey replied: Gracias Papá.
Four words. Two languages. One family.

[Verse 2 - Arabic, with English translations]
كوري أرسل الرابط. كيفن ساندرز. واحد وثلاثون. روح حرة. (Corey sent the link. Kevin Sanders. Thirty-one. Free spirit.)
رد تشاس بكلمتين بالإسبانية: لو سينتو. (Chas replied two words in Spanish: Lo siento.)
رد كوري: غراسياس بابا. (Corey replied: Gracias Papá.)
أربع كلمات. لغتان. عائلة واحدة. (Four words. Two languages. One family.)
لو سينتو تحمل شيئاً (Lo siento carries something)
أحياناً لا تحمله I'm sorry (That I'm sorry sometimes doesn't)
وتشاس يعرف ذلك (And Chas knows that)
قالها بالطريقة الصحيحة (He said it the right way)

[Chorus - Māori, with English translations]
Lo siento (Lo siento)
Ko Chas tērā i kī ai (That is what Chas said)
Lo siento (Lo siento)
He aroha tōna (His love)
Lo siento (Lo siento)
Hei reo Pāniora (In the Spanish language)
Lo siento (Lo siento)
Ki tōna tamaiti (To his child)
Lo siento (Lo siento)
Mō te hoa kua mate (For the friend who died)
Ko Gracias Papá te whakahoki (Gracias Papá was the reply)
Whā kupu (Four words)
Reo rua (Two languages)
Whānau kotahi (One family)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Language is character in advance. Lo siento. The right words at the right time.
Arabic: اللغة هي الشخصية مسبقاً. لو سينتو. الكلمات الصحيحة في الوقت الصحيح. (Language is character in advance. Lo siento. The right words at the right time.)
Māori: Ko te reo, ko te ahua o te tangata i mua. Lo siento. Ngā kupu tika i te wā tika. (Language is character in advance. Lo siento. Right words at the right time.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Lo siento — Gracias Papá — four words — one family
Arabic: لو سينتو — غراسياس بابا — أربع كلمات — عائلة واحدة (Lo siento — Gracias Papá — four words — one family)
Māori: Lo siento — Gracias Papá — whā kupu — whānau kotahi (Lo siento — Gracias Papá — four words — one family)
